name: Sales view does not multiply rows when grouped by a joined dimension
note:
The real risk in a view is FAN-OUT. Sales pulls Businesspartner in over a join_path, and if that join is not one-to-one the measure inflates - silently, because the number still looks like a plausible order count. Grouping by a dimension sourced from the JOINED cube and summing must still give 110,854, identical to the ungrouped total and to the source.

Businesspartner_c_bpartner_name is chosen deliberately: it is a STRING, so validate.mjs picks the measure as the first numeric value in each row rather than the dimension.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-09-01'
